solutionSql:
SELECT DISTINCT ON (shipment_id)
       shipment_id,
       status,
       occurred_at,
       id AS event_id
FROM shipment_events
ORDER BY shipment_id, occurred_at DESC, id DESC;
notes: Ticket not in this revision; SQL and record unchanged. DISTINCT ON with ORDER BY shipment_id, occurred_at DESC, id DESC, so the larger id wins a timestamp tie. Sample rows checked by hand: shipment 2 gives event 2, shipment 3 event 5, shipment 4 event 8. The ties dataset returned 163 rows; I did not inspect its tied events.
